decision: ADR-020 §3: minimal Action/queue authority for NexLoop's own service principals, applied by the scheduler through trusted configuration (0050) only. v2: claim_matcher follows successor versions of Consumer.edit published by human review decisions (follow_latest_version). v3: claim_matcher per-object Consumer property READ/EDIT derived from a type rule (property_access_rules, docs/implementation/property-grant-derivation.md); restricted groups come only from the separate owner file deploy/authorization/owner-property-restrictions.json.

principals.purpose: Debounce accepted conversations and enqueue one idempotent extraction window per conversation.
Claim extraction tasks from the durable queue and record Claims through the governed extraction function.
Four-layer Claim matching and the governed formal write of accepted matches.
Lease Run activation tasks from the operations queue and hand them to the Agent Host guard.
Materialize a channel-accepted Agent reply as a Message through the governed Message.agent_create Action; never sends, never chooses text or delivery state.
Assemble Context packs (NX-023): read the current strategy; every evidence source is still read under its own current object/property READ.
Route an accepted inbound Message to a Run activation event.

grants.purpose: Read the extraction feed (due/mark/backlog) bound to the extract Action.
Accept one idempotent queue event per extraction window.
Claim/finish extraction tasks under lease and fence.
Record match proposals and staged candidates.
Governed formal Consumer property write of an accepted match (object/property EDIT still required per object).
Governed creation of a referenced Product when matching resolves to a new instance.
Type-level schema read for candidate generation.
Type-level schema read for candidate generation.
Claim/renew/finish Run activation tasks (queue name as deployed by the message recipe).
Route an accepted inbound Message into a Run activation.
Governed creation of the Message object for an outbound reply already accepted by the channel (ADR-020 §2).
Read the current Context strategy through authz.nexloop_context_read (strategy verb); grants no object or property READ.

deferred.reason: Real outbound effect execution; channel enablement and REAL_DISPATCH_ENABLED need the owner's own confirmation (ADR-020 §3).
Provider query of real outbound effects; enabled together with the channel by the owner.
Receipt reconciliation of real outbound effects; enabled together with the channel by the owner.
Per-message READ for Source/extraction worker is derived from governed facts (ADR-020 §1, NX-047), never a static grant.
Per-object authority of the matcher depends on instance data; needs governed derivation, not a static manifest.
Held by Run-bound Source credentials issued per Run (0034), not by a standing service principal.
Planning authority belongs to Agent/Run credentials (NX-022/NX-024), not service principals.
Owner control configuration; human owner authority.
Browser human identity link flow; human authority.
Recorded by the Run Source path of an outbound request; follows the effect channel decision.

property_access_rules.purpose: Apply accepted Claims to every real-world Consumer without per-object grants; all ten ADR-019 §2 groups (owner decision 2026-10-09: none restricted); groups restricted by the owner are never derived.

excluded_by_policy: Human principal authority of any kind
